verdict.rationale: AutoGen supports running agent teams in an isolated Docker container (docs-17) and community reports confirm docker-based isolation for code execution (autogen-comm-2), which provides a sandboxed execution environment, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'test vs production data' separation or staging environment feature for AI-native testing workflows. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment tied to production data separation, first-party guidance on test-vs-prod data isolation, independent verification beyond a single HN thread.
